title: plugin-detail: `record:related_list` reads `showViewAll` and passes `onViewAll`, so the "View all" link the spec declares (default true) draws — ENFORCE, the objectui half of objectstack#23941
body:
Filing gate **④, a cross-repo child**: the objectui half of objectstack-ai/objectstack#23941 (`domain:spec`, p1, `target:v18`, enforce-or-remove).

- **Filed by:** objectstack `domain:spec` seat 2 (seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#18549) · `os-bill` · session `session_01LFqdRsuM5nkqoJdHd5ztVk`. ⛔ Not a claim.
- **Who acts:** the objectui seat that triage routes this card to. The grade and the route are triage's.

## The verdict: ENFORCE, inherited

- **The precedent.** objectstack-ai/objectstack#20665 is the same component, `record:related_list`, and the same pattern: a key that is declared and read by no renderer. It sits in the same family, ruling A′ ④ of #8071. It was ruled by the maintainer, verbatim: 「20665 业务上需要支持，ENFORCE」 (ruling `5902374623`, 2026-09-30). This card delivered it: #11163, PR #11263.
- **Why it carries over.** The seat applies that ruling to `showViewAll` under the dispatch protocol's sibling rule: a new branch reuses the parent ruling together with its reason. The reason, business pull, is measured here rather than assumed. The platform's own pages author the key on 13 related lists (objectstack `main` `adce192974`, `git grep -c "showViewAll: true"`):
  - `packages/platform-objects/src/pages/sys-user.page.ts` (9);
  - `sys-organization.page.ts` (3);
  - `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/sys-approval-request.page.ts` (1).
- **The spec side does not move.** `packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts:1734` keeps `showViewAll: z.boolean().default(true).describe('Show "View All" link to see all related records')`.

## Measured (objectui `main` `c9e67425`)

- `packages/plugin-detail/src/RelatedList.tsx:2497` draws the View-all link only when `onViewAll && !isEmpty && showPagination`. The prop is declared at `:101`.
- `packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/record-related-list.tsx` renders `<RelatedList` at `:548`, but never reads `showViewAll` and never passes `onViewAll`. No other host passes `onViewAll` to `RelatedList`; the `onViewAll` in `app-shell/src/console/home/` is the home rail's own, unrelated prop.
- `showViewAll` appears only in the input registry (`plugin-detail/src/index.tsx:677`), the type (`types/src/record-components.ts:534`) and two tests. So the declared default `true` draws nothing today.

## What done looks like

- `record-related-list.tsx` reads `showViewAll`: absent counts as `true`, the spec's default. Unless it is `false`, the renderer passes an `onViewAll` that opens the related object's records filtered to this parent record, on the relationship the list already resolves.
- **Premise to measure first:** a route that exists today can show that filtered list, such as the object list view with the relationship filter. If none can, report the fork on objectstack#23941 instead of inventing a page. The objectstack seat then re-runs the enforce-or-remove reading.
- `showViewAll: false` draws no link. An empty list draws none either, as `RelatedList` already does.
- The read site is booked in `apps/console/src/__tests__/registry-inputs-spec-parity.test.ts`, the way `record:related_list.actions` was by #11263. Pins cover default-on, `false`-off and the navigation target.
- ⛔ No consumer-side reinterpretation of the key. The link means "see all related records", as the spec's describe says.

## On landing

objectstack#23941 closes once this lands in objectui `main`, as #20665 closed on #11263. No objectstack PR is owed, because the key stays as declared.

Dedupe: MCP `search_issues` in objectui, closed included, at objectstack#23941's filing: `showViewAll related list View all onViewAll` returned 0 hits. Re-read after this filing, MCP `search_issues` in objectui `showViewAll View all link related list onViewAll` returned 1 hit, this card.
